text_en: Therefore be imitators of God, as beloved children,
text_cn: 所以你们应该效法天主，如同蒙宠爱的儿女一样；

text_en: and live in love, as Christ loved us and gave himself up for us, a fragrant offering and sacrifice to God.
text_cn: 又应该在爱德中生活，就如基督爱了我们，且为我们把自己交出，献于天主作为馨香的供物和祭品。

text_en: But fornication and impurity of any kind, or greed, must not even be mentioned among you, as is proper among saints.
text_cn: 至于邪淫，一切不洁和贪婪之事，在你们中间，连提也不要提：如此才合乎圣徒的身分。

text_en: Entirely out of place is obscene, silly, and vulgar talk; but instead, let there be thanksgiving.
text_cn: 同样，猥亵、放荡和轻薄的戏言，都不相宜；反要说感恩的话，

text_en: Be sure of this, that no fornicator or impure person, or one who is greedy (that is, an idolater), has any inheritance in the kingdom of Christ and of God.
text_cn: 因为你们应该清楚知道：不论是犯邪淫的，行不洁的，或是贪婪的──即崇拜偶像的──在基督和天主的国内，都不得承受产业。

text_en: Let no one deceive you with empty words, for because of these things the wrath of God comes on those who are disobedient.
text_cn: 不要让任何人以浮言欺骗你们，因为就是为了这些事，天主的忿怒才降在这些悖逆之子身上。

text_en: Therefore do not be associated with them.
text_cn: 所以你们不要作这些人的同伴。

text_en: For once you were darkness, but now in the Lord you are light. Live as children of light—
text_cn: 从前你们原是黑暗，但现在你们在主内却是光明，生活自然要像光明之子一样；

text_en: for the fruit of the light is found in all that is good and right and true.
text_cn: 光明所结的果实，就是各种良善、正义和诚实，

text_en: Try to find out what is pleasing to the Lord.
text_cn: 你们要体察什么是主所喜悦的；

text_en: Take no part in the unfruitful works of darkness, but instead expose them.
text_cn: 不要参与黑暗无益的作为，反要加以指摘，

text_en: For it is shameful even to mention what such people do secretly;
text_cn: 因为他们暗中所行的事，就是连提起，也是可耻的。

text_en: but everything exposed by the light becomes visible,
text_cn: 凡一切事，一经指摘，便由光显露出来；因为凡显露出来的，就成了光明；

text_en: for everything that becomes visible is light. Therefore it says, “Sleeper, awake! Rise from the dead, and Christ will shine on you. ”
text_cn: 为此说：“你这睡眠的，醒起来吧！从死者中起来吧！基督必要光照你！”

text_en: Be careful then how you live, not as unwise people but as wise,
text_cn: 所以，你们应细心观察自己怎样生活；不要像无知的人，却要像明智的人；

text_en: making the most of the time, because the days are evil.
text_cn: 应把握时机，因为这些时日是邪恶的；

text_en: So do not be foolish, but understand what the will of the Lord is.
text_cn: 因此不要作糊涂人，但要晓得什么是主的旨意。

text_en: Do not get drunk with wine, for that is debauchery; but be filled with the Spirit,
text_cn: 也不要醉酒，醉酒使人淫乱；却要充满圣神，

text_en: as you sing psalms and hymns and spiritual songs among yourselves, singing and making melody to the Lord in your hearts,
text_cn: 以圣咏、诗词及属神的歌曲，互相对谈，在你们心中歌颂赞美主；

text_en: giving thanks to God the Father at all times and for everything in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ.
text_cn: 为一切事，要因我们的主耶稣基督的名，时时感谢天主父；

text_en: Be subject to one another out of reverence for Christ.
text_cn: 又要怀着敬畏基督的心，互相顺从。

text_en: Wives, be subject to your husbands as you are to the Lord.
text_cn: 你们作妻子的，应当服从自己的丈夫，如同服从主一样，

text_en: For the husband is the head of the wife just as Christ is the head of the church, the body of which he is the Savior.
text_cn: 因为丈夫是妻子的头，如同基督是教会的头，他又是这身体的救主。

text_en: Just as the church is subject to Christ, so also wives ought to be, in everything, to their husbands.
text_cn: 教会怎样服从基督，作妻子的也应怎样事事服从丈夫。

text_en: Husbands, love your wives, just as Christ loved the church and gave himself up for her,
text_cn: 你们作丈夫的，应该爱妻子，如同基督爱了教会，并为她舍弃了自己，

text_en: in order to make her holy by cleansing her with the washing of water by the word,
text_cn: 以水洗，藉言语，来洁净她，圣化她，

text_en: so as to present the church to himself in splendor, without a spot or wrinkle or anything of the kind—yes, so that she may be holy and without blemish.
text_cn: 好使她在自己面前呈现为一个光耀的教会，没有瑕疵，没有皱纹，或其他类似的缺陷；而使她成为圣洁和没有污点的。

text_en: In the same way, husbands should love their wives as they do their own bodies. He who loves his wife loves himself.
text_cn: 作丈夫的也应当如此爱自己的妻子，如同爱自己的身体一样；那爱自己妻子的，就是爱自己，

text_en: For no one ever hates his own body, but he nourishes and tenderly cares for it, just as Christ does for the church,
text_cn: 因为从来没有人恨过自己的肉身，反而培养抚育它，一如基督之对教会；

text_en: because we are members of his body.
text_cn: 因为我们都是他身上的肢体。

text_en: “For this reason a man will leave his father and mother and be joined to his wife, and the two will become one flesh. ”
text_cn: “为此，人应离开自己的父母，依附自己的妻子，二人成为一体。”

text_en: This is a great mystery, and I am applying it to Christ and the church.
text_cn: 这奥秘真是伟大！但我是指基督和教会说的。

text_en: Each of you, however, should love his wife as himself, and a wife should respect her husband.
text_cn: 总之，你们每人应当各爱自己的妻子，就如爱自己一样；至于妻子，应该敬重自己的丈夫。
